slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked when purchases occur relative to monthly sales, and did not explicitly flag this timing assumption for confirmation. The questions about purchase/sale limits and minimum inventory do not cover this slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchase timing within the month is irrelevant; the inventory capacity constraint can be checked only using end-of-month inventory as Beginning inventory + Purchases - Sales.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month, so the intra-month inventory peak and capacity timing were not confirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing remained unresolved, even though this timing affects how warehouse capacity should be modeled.

summary: The agent clarified several boundaries but never asked about the timing of purchases within each month, leaving an unresolved P1 assumption and stopping with a potentially incomplete capacity treatment.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
